dish.title: Sheet-Pan Margherita Pizza
dish.description: Store-bought pizza dough pressed into an olive-oiled sheet pan, topped with a simple crushed-tomato sauce and torn fresh mozzarella, baked hot until crisp underneath, and finished with fresh basil.

recipe_version.title: Sheet-Pan Margherita Pizza
recipe_version.description: Store-bought pizza dough pressed into an olive-oiled sheet pan, topped with a simple crushed-tomato sauce and torn fresh mozzarella, baked hot until crisp underneath, and finished with fresh basil.

ingredients.name: raw pizza dough
ingredients.note: HARD CONTRACT: 24 oz store-bought raw (unbaked) pizza dough ball(s) from the refrigerated or bakery case. Ingredients limited to wheat flour, water, yeast, salt, oil, and optionally sugar — no milk, egg, cheese, or soy flour in the dough. Not a prebaked crust, not a canned tube dough, not a frozen pizza. Wheat.
ingredients.preparation: straight from the refrigerator into the oiled pan

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: divided: 2 tbsp to oil the sheet pan (this fries the crust bottom crisp), 1 tbsp stirred into the tomato sauce

ingredients.name: canned crushed tomatoes
ingredients.note: from one 14–15 oz can; plain crushed tomatoes, not a seasoned pizza or marinara sauce

ingredients.name: fresh mozzarella
ingredients.note: REQUIRED DAIRY. HARD CONTRACT: fresh mozzarella balls (packed in water or whey) made with microbial or vegetable rennet — label says vegetarian, microbial enzymes, or non-animal rennet. Not low-moisture shredded mozzarella, not burrata, not vegan cheese. Milk allergen.
ingredients.preparation: torn into 1-inch pieces and blotted dry on paper towels

ingredients.name: fresh basil
ingredients.note: loosely packed leaves (about 20 leaves); added after baking so it stays green

steps.title: Heat the oven and oil the pan with the dough
steps.body: Set a rack in the lower third of the oven and heat the oven to 475 F (it needs about 20 minutes and will be ready before the pizza goes in). Pour 2 tbsp of the extra-virgin olive oil onto a 13x18-inch rimmed half-sheet pan and spread it to the corners. Set the cold store-bought dough in the pan, turn it once to coat with oil, and press it into a rough rectangle with your fingertips. Cover loosely with a clean towel and let it rest 20 minutes so the gluten relaxes. About 5 minutes of work; the 20-minute rest begins now.

steps.title: Make the sauce and prep the mozzarella during the rest
steps.body: Stir together the crushed tomatoes, grated garlic, 1 tbsp of the extra-virgin olive oil, and the 1/2 tsp kosher salt. This sauce is not cooked ahead; it reduces on the pizza. Drain the fresh mozzarella, tear it into 1-inch pieces, spread them on paper towels, and press more towels on top to blot surface water so the pizza does not puddle. Pick the basil leaves and tear any large ones. About 10 minutes, inside the dough rest.

steps.title: Press the dough to the corners
steps.body: When the dough has rested the full 20 minutes (about 10 minutes after the sauce is done), press it outward with oiled fingertips toward the corners and edges, dimpling as you go, about 3 minutes. It will spring back. Rest 5 minutes more, then press again until it fills the pan to the corners in an even layer, about 2 minutes. About 20 minutes including the remaining rest time.

steps.title: Sauce and first bake
steps.body: Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border. Bake on the lower rack at 475 F until the edges are set and lightly golden and the underside is starting to brown, about 12 minutes. Baking the sauced crust first keeps the fresh mozzarella from weeping before the base sets. About 12 minutes.

steps.title: Add mozzarella and finish the bake
steps.body: Pull the pan out and scatter the blotted fresh mozzarella pieces evenly over the sauce. Return to the lower rack and bake until the cheese is melted, bubbling, and lightly spotted golden and the crust underneath is deep golden and crisp when you lift a corner with a spatula, about 9 minutes. About 9 minutes.

steps.title: Rest, add basil, and cut
steps.body: Let the pizza rest in the pan 3 minutes so the cheese sets. Scatter the fresh basil leaves over the top, then slide the pizza onto a board (or cut in the pan with a pizza wheel) and cut into 12 squares. No pepperoni, no prosciutto, no Parmesan shower. kitchen_tested is false. About 3 minutes.

components.name: store-bought pizza dough base
components.contract: Store-bought raw pizza dough limited to wheat flour, water, yeast, salt, oil, optional sugar; no milk/egg/cheese/soy flour.

recipe_version.time_clock: Prep 15 = 5 oil pan + set dough (oven preheat starts) + 10 sauce / tear and blot mozzarella / pick basil (inside the 20-minute dough rest). Cook 44 = 10 remaining dough rest + 3 first press + 5 rest + 2 second press + 12 sauced first bake + 9 mozzarella bake + 3 rest and basil. Total 59. Oven preheat (~20 min) is done by minute 20; the pizza goes in at minute 35.
recipe_version.heat: Oven 475 F, rack in the lower third, preheated about 20 minutes. Oiled heavy sheet pan directly on the rack — no pizza stone, no broiler, no grill.
recipe_version.doneness: Underside deep golden and crisp when a corner is lifted (not pale or doughy); edges golden and puffed. Fresh mozzarella melted, bubbling, lightly spotted — not separated into oil and not browned to rubber. Sauce reduced and jammy, not watery. Basil bright green, added after baking. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.dietary_label_note: No dairy_free label: fresh mozzarella is required. vegetarian_compatible is true by hard contract — the mozzarella must be made with microbial or vegetable rennet, and the dough contract excludes animal fats. Not plant-based. Following the wave-10 dairy-main precedent (lemon-pea-risotto microbial-rennet Parmesan), the vegetarian claim lives in dietary_eligibility and no vegetarian label is stamped.

scaling_notes.1: 6 oz dough in a quarter-sheet pan (9x13) or 8-inch square pan with 2 tsp oil; about 1/3 cup sauce (1 tsp oil, pinch salt, small garlic grate); 3 oz mozzarella; 5–6 basil leaves. Same 475 F lower rack; first bake about 10 minutes, cheese bake about 7–8.
scaling_notes.2: 12 oz dough in a 9x13 quarter-sheet pan with 1 tbsp oil; half the sauce, mozzarella, and basil. First bake about 11 minutes, cheese bake about 8.
scaling_notes.4: As written: 1 1/2 lb dough, 13x18 half-sheet pan, 59-minute clock, 12 squares.
